svg.text: Aangan Studio, Pune / Every phone enquiry, answered and graded — Components Map
Switches to Hindi or Marathi if the
caller does. Never says a price —
not a rate, not a range, ever
Offers only times the tool returns —
the agent cannot see a day otherwise
then the rest in after(). A call that
never connected is dropped, not carded.
A mid-call hold is adopted by its call
Reads rubric.md as its system prompt.
Pulls out the fields, writes the summary,
Re-derives every criterion from the rubric
and the pricing bands — area × band vs
Eight columns, drag to move. Each card:
what to do next — and the internal
Deal created the first time a card leaves
New. Every later move syncs the stage;
a failed sync is retried by cron
What actually makes money: by property
type and by scope. Cost per hot lead,

No price ever reaches a caller · the agent books only what a tool confirms · a failed call never becomes a lead · nothing is silently dropped — a LOW lead stays on the board until someone closes it with a reason

Live: aangan-leads.vercel.app · Next.js 15 on Vercel · Neon Postgres · Gemini 3.8 Flash (JSON mode, temperature 0) · Vaani AI voice + custom tools · Cal.com v2 · Telegram Bot API · HubSpot CRM · Asia/Kolkata
